    AI Overview
    Actor
    Val Kilmer
    died on April 1, 2025, at age 65 in Los Angeles from pneumonia    . He had been battling throat cancer since 2014, which had previously necessitated a tracheostomy. His family confirmed the death, noting he passed away surrounded by loved ones. 
    • Final Years and Health: After his 2014 cancer diagnosis, Kilmer suffered from long-term health issues, including the loss of his voice, but continued to work, appearing in Top Gun: Maverick (2022).
    • Legacy and AI Usage: Following his death, Kilmer’s family authorized the use of AI to replicate his voice and likeness for a new film, "As Deep as the Grave" (announced 2026), to allow him to act despite his passing.
    • Tributes: Tom Cruise, his Top Gun co-star, publicly honored him at CinemaCon shortly after his passing. 
    Kilmer was known for his roles in Top Gun, Batman Forever, Tombstone, and The Doors.

    Why did Val Kilmer pass away?

    AI Overview
    Val Kilmer passed away at age 65 on April 1, 2025, in Los Angeles, due to pneumonia. While he had previously recovered from a 2014 throat cancer diagnosis, his death was also linked to underlying complications, including acute hypoxemic respiratory failure and lasting effects from his prior cancer treatment. 
    Details regarding Val Kilmer's passing: 
    • Cause of Death: Confirmed as pneumonia, with contributing factors including acute hypoxemic respiratory failure, chronic respiratory failure, and prior squamous cell carcinoma of the base of the tongue.
    • Previous Health Struggles:
      Following a 2014 throat cancer diagnosis, Kilmer underwent extensive treatment, including two tracheotomies, which affected his voice.
    • Final Days: According to TMZ, he was bedridden for months before his death and was surrounded by family.
    • Legacy: Kilmer was a celebrated actor known for roles in Top Gun, The Doors, and Batman Forever. 
    His daughter, Mercedes Kilmer, confirmed the news shortly after his passing.
